name: Note
text: One entry per shot: shot ID, plate source, required elements (CG, roto, paint, comp), estimated hours, current status (not started / WIP / review / final).

name: Note
text: Rough blocking, camera moves, and timing references — animatics or storyboards that define what each shot needs to accomplish before final work starts.

name: Note
text: Camera solve quality per shot, lens distortion data, ground-plane/scale references, and any markers or witness cameras used on set.

name: Note
text: Reusable comp setups: your standard keying rig, your grain-match node group, your standard CG-over-plate holdout setup. Screenshot or link to your template project file.

name: Note
text: Dated feedback per round: "v1 — director wants explosion bigger and warmer." Keep old rounds instead of overwriting so you can see how the shot evolved.

name: Note
text: Any 3D models, textures, or stock elements (explosions, sparks, smoke sims) sourced for this project — with license/usage terms noted.

name: Note
text: Resolution, frame rate, color space (Rec.709 / ACES), codec, and file-naming convention required by the client or studio for final delivery.
